scope: Current regular passenger service as of October 2026 (limited express / Shinkansen / excursion / retired / test cars excluded). Through-running stock listed on every line it regularly appears on.
method: Facts compiled from Wikipedia (en for NYC, ja for Tokyo) fetched via the MediaWiki API on 2026-10-01; image licences from Commons extmetadata (via ja.wikipedia API). Operator sites were NOT fetched in this pass. Dimensions: lengthHeadM/lengthMiddleM = length over couplers (NYC: over anticlimbers), widthM = max/side-lamp width unless noted, heightM = roof/AC-top height (pantograph-down height in source where noted). Colours: hex values are estimates unless estimated=false.

lineUsageLegend.main: principal/most frequent type on that line
lineUsageLegend.minor: minority, through-running, phasing-out or partial-section type

lineCoverageNotes.I: Through stock from Tokyu Meguro and Sotetsu 21000; Metro 9000 only on shared Shirokane-takanawa–Meguro section.
lineCoverageNotes.S: Includes Keio 9000 (30番台) and Keio 5000 through stock.
lineCoverageNotes.A: Through stock from Keisei, Hokuso/CNT and Keikyu.
lineCoverageNotes.T: Includes JR E231-800 and Toyo Rapid 2000 through stock.
lineCoverageNotes.C: Includes JR E233-2000 and Odakyu 4000 through stock.
lineCoverageNotes.Y: Through stock from Tobu Tojo and Seibu.
lineCoverageNotes.Z: Through stock from Tokyu Den-en-toshi and Tobu.
lineCoverageNotes.N: Through stock from Tokyu Meguro, Saitama Railway and Sotetsu 21000.
lineCoverageNotes.F: Through stock from Tokyu, Tobu, Seibu, Sotetsu and Yokohama Minatomirai.
lineCoverageNotes.JE: Musashino-line through trains (209-500, E231) also reach Tokyo via Keiyo tracks.
lineCoverageNotes.SW: Seibu 101 only; ex-Tokyu 9000 (Seibu 7000) planned here — not confirmed in service as of Oct 2026.
lineCoverageNotes.TSK: Tobu 10030 2-car one-man (8000 series retired from Kameido/Daishi July 2025).
lineCoverageNotes.R: TWR 70-000 being replaced by 71-000; JR E233-7000 and Sotetsu 12000 through.

sustina-family bodies; fronts differ (Sotetsu & Tokyu need own nose)
